note: Promoted fitted state for the governed Light RUC finalist recipe. Decision-facing paths LOAD this state; they do not refit at score time. Refitting made Light RUC the only stream whose forecast depended on the machine running it (up to 0.48% across platforms, while PED and Heavy RUC agreed to machine epsilon). A refit implementation remains only as a non-production promotion utility.

state_policy.model_recipe: dynamic_RESID_GBR_n150_d1_lr0.05_w36; Schiff-style OLS base plus GBM residual correction on the log target
state_policy.runtime_behaviour: load_light_ruc_promoted_state() in model_dashboard/forecast_runner.py; fails closed if the hash, feature contract, hyperparameters or archived training-fit replay do not match
state_policy.retraining_policy: A data update does NOT silently retrain. Refit under the pinned runtime in requirements.txt, run the backtest and parity gates, write a new state artefact with its hashes and training cutoff, review the before/after impact report, then promote. Until promotion, the existing state stays authoritative.
state_policy.parity_requirement: Windows and Linux must agree to machine epsilon, the same standard PED and Heavy RUC meet; enforced by the replay-parity CI matrix.
